title: Transit: ingestion task panic logged as clean drain (JoinHandle Ok(_) swallows JoinError)
description: In crates/transit/src/main.rs lines 930-933, the match on drain_result uses Ok(_) which matches both Ok(Ok(())) (clean task exit) and Ok(Err(JoinError)) (task panic). When the ingestion task panics, drain_result is Ok(Err(JoinError)), which falls into the Ok(_) arm and logs 'ingestion task drained cleanly'. This silently swallows a task panic and gives the operator a false clean-exit signal. The process then continues to the 'usenet-ipfs-transit stopped' log and exits with code 0. Fix: match Ok(Ok(())) explicitly and match Ok(Err(e)) as a separate arm that logs the panic reason and exits non-zero.
